meta.title: About HoursMedia
meta.description: HoursMedia is a digital agency focused on websites, customer journeys, automation and custom tools, built honestly and handed over cleanly.

about.title: A small agency built around doing this well
about.intro: We are HoursMedia. We help businesses present themselves clearly online, then make sure the enquiries that arrive actually get handled.

story.title: Why we exist
paragraphs: Most businesses do not have a website problem or an automation problem in isolation. They have a journey problem: attention arrives, then leaks away somewhere between a slow page, a shared inbox and a follow-up nobody sent.

We built HoursMedia to treat that journey as one thing. Presence, operations and custom tools are designed together, so the website, the systems and the people using them all point the same direction.
We would rather be honest than impressive. We label our concepts as concepts, we do not promise rankings we cannot control, and we tell you when a simpler tool will do the job.

honesty.title: Honesty
honesty.body: No fake reviews, no hidden fees, no guarantees we cannot keep.

craft.title: Craft
craft.body: Details matter: fast pages, readable type, accessible controls.

ownership.title: Your ownership
ownership.body: Your accounts, your data and your site stay yours, with documentation to match.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.body: Plain language, defined scopes and no surprise invoices.
